import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { customers } from "./customers";
import { employees } from "./employees";
import { shippers } from "./shippers";
import { orderDetails } from "./order_details";

export const orders = defineTable("orders", {
    columns: {
        orderId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        customerId: col.varchar(5),
        employeeId: col.smallint(),
        orderDate: col.date(),
        requiredDate: col.date(),
        shippedDate: col.date(),
        shipVia: col.smallint(),
        freight: col.real(),
        shipName: col.varchar(40),
        shipAddress: col.varchar(60),
        shipCity: col.varchar(15),
        shipRegion: col.varchar(15),
        shipPostalCode: col.varchar(10),
        shipCountry: col.varchar(15)
    },
    relations: {
        customer: rel.belongsTo(() => customers, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        employee: rel.belongsTo(() => employees, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        shipViaRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => shippers, { localKey: "ship_via", onDelete: "no action" }),
        order_details: rel.hasMany(() => orderDetails)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
